# TASK-063 — PostgreSQL JSONB persistence, pgvector semantic search and permission-filtered section search

- **Status:** Done — implemented and verified
- **Area:** Expanded scope (see expanded-scope.md for acceptance criteria)

## Intent

PostgreSQL JSONB canonical persistence and pgvector semantic search, plus permission-filtered full-text search of every document section. Preserve IDs/revisions. Updated 2026-09-28 at the user's request: SDD Studio does not provide MongoDB runtime or data-migration support; legacy data must be transformed outside the application.

## What it delivers

MongoDB is not an application database and no Mongo runtime or migration tool is maintained; legacy data must be transformed externally. PostgreSQL-backed CI tests, including vector and section search, passed locally under act. Tests: `tests/search-vector.test.ts`, `tests/migrations.test.ts`; backend tests start a Testcontainers PostgreSQL with pgvector when `DATABASE_URL` is not set.
